outcome.Summary: Implemented `Query(doc any, path string) ([]any, error)` in jpath/jpath.go. The parser tokenizes the path after `$` into member (`.name` with identifier validation, `["key"]` with `\"`/`\\` escapes and `]` inside quotes), index (`[N]`, negative allowed, `strconv.Atoi` validation), wildcard (`[*]` and `.*`), and recursive (`..name`) steps; invalid shapes (no `$`, `$.`, `$[`, `$[1`, `$["x]`, `$.1abc`, `$[abc]`, empty names) return a non-nil error and nil result. Evaluation maps each step over the current node list: inapplicable steps contribute nothing, wildcards expand arrays in order and objects by ascending key, and recursive descent emits a node's own `name` match first then recurses into children (object children key-ordered, array children in order), always producing a non-nil slice. Verified with the existing test plus a temporary edge-case suite (malformed paths, negative indices, ordering, escapes, empty matches) which was removed afterward; `gofmt`, `go vet`, and `go test ./...` all pass.
